facts.meaning: Kernel.validate is private. Its sole argument must be a Hash; otherwise it raises ArgumentError before iterating. Conditions that are Arrays accept when any listed class/module satisfies value.is_a?. A Symbol condition checks value.respond_to?(symbol). Other conditions are given to value.is_a?.
facts.failure_and_limits: Class/module validation admits subclasses and is not coercion, bounds checking, nested-field validation or method-arity validation. A condition unsuitable for native is_a? may raise outside the intended accumulated-error result; caller must supply supported condition shapes.

facts.meaning: For supported conditions it traverses all Hash entries, builds failure strings, compacts nonfailures and returns nil if none remain; otherwise raises one ArgumentError combining the errors with CRLF.
facts.failure_and_limits: Successful checks do not replace or normalize values. A caller Hash has already been constructed before validate; equal Hash keys can collapse at that construction, so this API cannot promise preserving a caller conceptual list of repeated equal-value checks. No rollback of prior caller writes.

facts.source_unit: Validation signature and complete method; specific creature callers remain receiver-owned
facts.meaning: For a caller such as money=(value), validate value=>Integer occurs before that caller clamp/assignment. This helper tests the supplied object, not every field reachable from it.
facts.failure_and_limits: Owner constructor and every other CRE caller must be read in their own complete order by CRE-A; this contribution does not assert its exact callback/assignment prefix. Native Integer/String/class ancestry semantics have no new target execution evidence.

facts.meaning: pbGetLanguage reads System.user_language once and switches on its [0..1] prefix: ja→1, en→2, fr→3, it→4, de→5, es→7, ko→8; any other successfully sliced prefix returns2. There is no mapping6 in this method.
facts.failure_and_limits: Matching is case-sensitive. A nil or unsliceable native return can fail before the default branch because there is no local rescue. No host language value, host availability or actual version has been observed.

facts.meaning: Trainer initialization normalizes trainer type, assigns name, consumes two rand(2**16) draws for ID, then stores pbGetLanguage result, then initializes party [].
facts.failure_and_limits: A host-language read failure follows prior trainer type/name/ID writes and random consumption and precedes party assignment. Exact host random sequence/OS language are UNVERIFIED and NOT_EXECUTED.

facts.source_unit: Utilities pbGetLanguage; StartGame/UILoad already accepted separately
facts.meaning: This native-language numeric mapping is independent of the Settings::LANGUAGES player-selected message-file index. Reading pbGetLanguage does not choose a configured translation file or persist PokemonSystem.language.
facts.failure_and_limits: Downstream foreign-language encounter/breeding/Pokedex-unit rules must use their actual caller contracts; no blanket equivalence of the two language identities is accepted.

common_premise: Fixed standard source, no override; host implementation/results not observed; caller checks require receiver independent complete source reading.
